id: D9-SHALLOW registered test of d = 9 B1 (d9_shallow/PLAN.md)
what: The constants and bindings of the D9-SHALLOW registered test; nothing here changes after the freeze commit F
code_digest_rule: convlines.provenance.code_digest(): the read path (convlines/*.py, timing/*.py, timing/d7/*, surf_v2/session.py, surf_v2/gpucheck.py) of surface_v2; equal to speed_rt/freeze_surf.json's

public_code.rule: every listed public file is used unchanged, at its path, by sha256

targets.basis: the speed re-test's Grace basis (fastest of three on the Linux workstation x its stage-2 fit, 1.5097605583565314); not timed again

claim.test: exact two-sided McNemar on the 1,000,000 test shots
criteria: (1) composite a + b + c on the Grace basis strictly below plain PM's target
(2) fewer failures than plain PM: p < alpha and the whole 97.5 % interval of the difference below 0
(3) fewer failures than correlated PM (as 2) and the composite strictly below correlated PM's target
claim.joining: intersection-union: the claim holds when every criterion holds; no further correction

composite.a: the slowest of the 5 accepted GPU processes of B1 (timing.gpu_term on the 200,000 timing shots)
composite.b: the slowest of the 3 accepted CPU processes' term_us (correlated PM's time over the routed timing shots / all 200,000 timing shots), x this session's applied factor for correlated PM (speed_rt.analysis_s.fit_s2)
composite.c: max(1.1 us, the router's estimate) of the accepted handoff process (timing.gpu_term --handoff at B1's tau)

publication_rule: The test and its outcome are published in the repository whatever the result. If the claim holds, the paper's d = 9 row becomes B1's pair (d9_b1w64_sh, q = 0.06). If it fails, or any timing part is not established, the paper keeps the 3-block row (d9_b3_sv2s1).
